record.title_md: Decomposing a connected graph into paths.

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Decomposing a connected graph into paths.
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Basic Graph Theory » Paths
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every simple connected graph on $ n $ vertices can be decomposed into at most $ \frac{1}{2}(n+1) $ paths.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture is tight because a complete graph on $ n $ vertices cannot be covered by less than $ (n+1)/2 $ cycles. There is a similar conjecture about decomposition of an eulerian graph into cycles .
dossier_meta.references_text: - * [L] L. Lovász, On covering of graphs. In Theory of Graphs (Proc. Colloq., Tihany, 1966), 231--236. Academic Press, New York, 1968.
